svg.title: Trust the Check, Not the Tone
svg.desc: An output-handling chain for invoice extraction: parse, check the schema, check that line items add up to the total, retry once with a repair prompt, then post or send to a human.
svg.text: Trust the Check, Not the Tone
Garnet Finance: a reply can parse, fit the schema and still be wrong.
Send the parser error back and ask again; a second
Name the missing field, due_date, and ask again
Do line items add up to
Items sum to 1,180.00 but the total says 1,810.00
